plan.why: Cassidy Williams works at GitHub advocating for developers using open source and modern developer tools, aligning well with Henry's goal to meet builders working on AI agents, creator tools, and developer storytelling at GitHub Universe.
angles: Highlight his experience building entertainment companies and IP with AI at Unicorn Studios, Animori, and Metacomica.
Mention his personal involvement in the BLACKPINK shoot to showcase hands-on creative production expertise.
Express interest in how GitHub supports developer advocacy and tools that could empower creators using AI.
openers: Hi Cassidy, I’m Henry from Unicorn Studios in San Francisco. I’ve been working on AI-powered entertainment projects and would love to hear about your work with developer advocacy at GitHub.
Hello Cassidy, I enjoyed the keynote. I build AI-driven IP in anime and comics, and I’m curious about GitHub’s tools for creators pushing AI in development.
plan.followUp: It was great connecting with Cassidy about how GitHub supports creators using AI tools. Follow up by exploring collaboration opportunities or sharing insights on AI agent development relevant to developer advocacy.
